title: Kavramlar Serisi: Bir Çizgi- Bir Ses - Bir Renk
author: Gülşah Yemen
description: These books enable direct access to concepts and achievements that support children’s cognitive, social, emotional and motor skills development. The goal of the first series is to help children express their imaginative and abstract thoughts. In the Series of Concepts, the author focuses on Line, Sound, and Color. A Line encourages children to imagine what they can create with different kinds of lines. A Color explores colorful clouds, forests, cities, animals, and more. A Sound invites children to listen to and imitate the many sounds around them.
